card.name: The word abdominal in symptom lists
card.fires_on: The word "abdominal" inside a list of withdrawal-type symptoms, right before "cramps". All the contexts show the same passage: "weakness, abdominal cramps, insomnia, nausea".

modes.label: Abdominal before cramps
modes.description: The word "abdominal" in a comma-separated symptom list after "weakness,".
modes.example: irritability, anxiety, backache, joint pain, weakness,<< abdominal>> cramps, insomnia, nausea, an

card.plain: It lights up on the word "abdominal" in a list of symptoms such as weakness, cramps and insomnia.
